content.title: How to watch Dodgers vs. Rockies: TV channel and streaming options for April 19
content.text: Dalton Rushing takes a two-game homer streak into the Los Angeles Dodgers’ game versus the Colorado Rockies at 3:10 p.m. ET on Sunday, at Coors Field. Roki Sasaki (0-2, 6.23 ERA) will start for the Dodgers, who are 15-5 this season and first in the NL West. Michael Lorenzen (1-2, 8.10 ERA) is starting for the Rockies, who are 8-13 and fifth in the NL West.How to watch Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Colorado Rockies Venue: Coors Field Time: 3:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: Rockies.TV and SportsNet LA Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has a 26.6% strikeout rate and a 6.3% walk rate in 79 plate appearances, and he has scored 11 total runs. Pages has recorded three steals on four attempts. In 89 plate appearances, Freddie Freeman has slashed .296/.360/.519 this season. He has hit three long balls and driven in 14 runs with a strikeout rate of 11.2% and a walk rate of 7.9%. He has come around to score nine times. Mickey Moniak has hit five home runs this season, which ranks 18th in MLB. He has also tallied nine RBIs and has scored eight runs. In 54 plate appearances, he has recorded a .260 BA, .296 OBP and .620 SLG with a 5.6% walk rate and a 25.9% strikeout rate. He has been effective on the base paths, recording one steal on one attempt. In 65 plate appearances, Troy Johnston has slashed .305/.359/.492 this season. He has hit two long balls and driven in 10 runs with a strikeout rate of 21.5% and a walk rate of 6.2%. He has stolen one base on two attempts and has scored seven runs.
